name: first_dependency_only
description: Realistic incomplete-loop bug: only the FIRST dependency in each node's dependency list is wired into the graph; any additional dependencies in the same list are silently ignored (e.g. written as `deps[0]` instead of iterating the whole list). Cycle detection and lexicographic tiebreaks are otherwise implemented correctly. This is exactly the failure mode the hidden test_multiple_implicit_dependencies docstring calls out ('an impl that registers only the FIRST implicit dep of each list misses core').
